## Mapping and cleanning 
The mapping of clean reads to the reference genome is done with `bwa-mem2` below.

```{bash}
ASM=../../data/RefGenomes/farionis-scaffolds.fa
PATHFQ=../2023-05-17/crepi_edits

if [ ! -d BAM ]; then mkdir BAM; fi
if [ ! -e ${ASM}.0123 ]; then
   bwa-mem2 index $ASM
fi

for i in $(ls $PATHFQ/*.trimmed_R1_.fastq.gz); do
   SAMPLE=$(basename $i .trimmed_R1_.fastq.gz)
   if [ ! -e BAM/${SAMPLE}.bam ]; then
      if [ ! -e BAM/${SAMPLE}_on_ref.sam ]; then
         bwa-mem2 mem -t 24 $ASM ${PATHFQ}/${SAMPLE}.trimmed_R1_.fastq.gz \
                                 ${PATHFQ}/${SAMPLE}.trimmed_R2_.fastq.gz \
                 -R "@RG\tID:${SAMPLE}\tSM:${SAMPLE}" > BAM/${SAMPLE}_on_ref.sam
      fi
      samtools sort BAM/${SAMPLE}_on_ref.sam -o BAM/temp_sorted.bam
      samtools view -b -F 4 -q 20 BAM/temp_sorted.bam > BAM/${SAMPLE}.bam
      #rm BAM/temp_sorted.bam
   fi
   if [ ! -e BAM/${SAMPLE}.bam.bai ]; then
      samtools index BAM/${SAMPLE}.bam
   fi
done
```

GATK4's `HaplotypeCaller` re-assembles every region with any evidence of variation. 
I suppose that's why GATK4 does not implement the `IndelRealigner`.

If `samtools` worked well, read groups must be correctly assigned, and we do not need
to use `AddOrReplaceReadGroups`.

```{bash INDEL, eval=FALSE}
ASM=../2023-05-15/ntedit_k31_edited.fa
PATHFQ=../2023-05-17/parasite/crepi_edits
GATK=/opt/gatk-4.4.0.0/gatk

#$GATK CreateSequenceDictionary -R $ASM -O crepi_k31.dict
DICT=$(dirname $ASM)/$(basename -s .fa $ASM).dict
if [ ! -e $DICT ]; then
   $GATK CreateSequenceDictionary -R $ASM -O $DICT
fi

if [ ! -e $ASM.fai ]; then
   samtools faidx $ASM
fi

SAMPLES=""
for data in $(ls BAM/*.bam); do
   SAMPLES=$SAMPLES" -I "$data
done

if [ ! -e crepi.vcf ]; then
   $GATK --java-options "-XX:ConcGCThreads=1 -Xmx100G"  \
         HaplotypeCaller -R $ASM -O crepi.vcf $SAMPLES 1> gatk.log 2> gatk.err
fi
```

### SNP calling

SNP calling: HaplotypeCaller GATK4
SNP extraction: vcftools (keep bi-allelic SNP with a calling quality above 20 and shared
                at least by 50% of the samples).

```{bash eval=FALSE}
ASM='../2023-05-15/ntedit_k31_edited.fa'

if [ ! -e crepi.recode.vcf ]; then
   vcftools --vcf crepi.vcf \
            --keep list_samples \
            --minGQ 20 \
            --thin 200 \
            --max-missing 0.5 \
            --min-alleles 2 \
            --max-alleles 2 \
            --remove-indels \
            --recode --recode_INFO_all
fi
```
